about_the_game:
Key Gameplay Features:

You and your team are elite detectives who have arrived on an isolated island where something terrible has happened. In "Mindwarp: AI Detective," time is your main adversary. Can you unravel the intricate web of lies and clues before the clock strikes midnight?

Investigation Preparation:

Team Assembly: In the menu, gather your team of detectives (play solo or team up with friends in co-op, or perhaps you'll want to compete with friends for the title of best detective!).

Scenario Start: Choose one of many unique detective scenarios. Customize your game mode and set off for the island, receiving a brief introduction to the case.

Immersive Investigation:

Island World: Explore a picturesque yet mysterious island, filled with atmospheric locations and hidden corners.

Living NPCs: Interact with the local residents – each has their own unique backstory, daily routine, and a host of secrets. Simply approach them and press a button to start a dialogue, ask questions, uncover contradictions, and gain valuable clues.

Clue Hunting: Thoroughly search the map – from secret notes to suspicious objects, every piece of evidence brings you closer to solving the mystery. Collect them, analyze them, and piece them together.

Race Against Time:

Limited Time: You have only one in-game day to gather as much information as possible, interrogate all witnesses, and find key evidence. Time waits for no one!

Decision Making: Before dusk, you must deliver your verdict: who committed the crime and how? An incorrect decision will mean failure.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 660
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Assemble your crew, sail to a mysterious island and solve a crime in one day! Interrogate NPCs with their own stories, search for clues and pass judgment before sunset in this unique detective adventure.
